definition: הִי (?) noun [masculine] lamentation, wailing , only Ezek 2:10 וְכָתוּב אֵלָיהָ קִינִים וָהֶגֶה וָהִי and written in it were lamentations and mourning and wailing ( ᵐ5 ουἀί , woe! Ew § 101 c compare אִי , compare III. אִי above, according to Thes Sta § 125 b and others הִי = נְהִי , נ being dropped; Ol § 77 g, 144 c would emend נְהִי so Co ; see נְהִי below נהה . Text very dubious). הִיא see הוּא . הֵידָד see below הדד . הֻיְּדוֺת see below ידה

הִי (?) noun [masculine] lamentation, wailing, only Ezek 2:10 וְכָתוּב אֵלָיהָ קִינִים וָהֶגֶה וָהִי and written in it were lamentations and mourning and wailing (ᵐ5 ουἀί, woe! Ew§ 101 c compare אִי, compare III. אִי above, according to Thes Sta§ 125 b and others הִי = נְהִי, נ being dropped; Ol§ 77 g, 144 c would emend נְהִי so Co; see נְהִי below נהה. Text very dubious).

הִיא see הוּא.

הֵידָד see below הדד.

הֻיְּדוֺת see below ידה
